name: Back Office
description: A cramped back room behind the counter, half storeroom and half office: boxes of unsorted stock, a desk buried under invoices, a kettle, and the back stairs up to the roof. A corkboard by the door is layered with flyers, postcards, and a single stubborn note in Iris's aunt's handwriting.
example_text: Back office: stock boxes, an invoice-buried desk, a kettle, a corkboard, and the stairs up to the roof.

properties.lighting: a single bare bulb and whatever leaks in from the counter
